errors.text_span: Секторите са подредени от най-голям към най-малък по часовниковата стрелка.
errors.evidence: The description claims the sectors are ordered from largest to smallest clockwise. However, starting from the largest sector (61%), the clockwise sequence of percentages is 4%, 15%, 20%, which is an ascending, not descending, order.
The description fails to mention the 3D effect of the pie chart, which is a prominent visual feature.
The description omits that each category in the legend is followed by the unit '(в км.)'.
